Russia: flames engulf buildings after Ukrainian drone attack in Voronezh region Copy/paste the link below: Copy Copy/paste the article video embed link below: Copy Updated: 26 October 2026 - 18:19 GMT+1 At least two people were killed and 17 injured in a Ukrainian drone attack on Russia's Voronezh region. Flames engulfed buildings, while falling debris struck a commuter train. … More Videos posted on Russian social media showed flames rising from apartment blocks and from the 25-storey Galereya Chizhova business centre , with thick black smoke drifting over neighbouring districts. Other footage showed burning private homes, a damaged commercial building, residential blocks with blown-out windows and at least ten cars ablaze in a car park. Residents picked through the wreckage, where drone engine fragments were found. ADVERTISEMENT ADVERTISEMENT Alexander Gusev , the governor, said air defences brought down 113 drones over the region, more than 70 of them directly above the city. Russia's defence ministry claimed 290 across the country . Debris also started fires at several industrial plants — local reports named the Voronezhsintezkauchuk rubber works and the VASO aircraft factory — as well as two dacha settlements, a school sports ground, a garage cooperative and an apartment building. The Novovoronezh nuclear plant said it was operating normally . Most of the injured were aboard the Anapa–Moscow train when debris struck near Somovo station , Russian Railways said. Five passengers were hurt , two seriously, and rail traffic through the city was suspended . Gusev confirmed three people were killed . Kyiv has not commented . Independent monitors could not establish whether the explosions beside apartment blocks were direct hits or falling debris , a distinction the governor's account leaves open. A strike on Voronezh three days earlier hit the Baltimor military airfield .
